name: 108-online
description: 108 ONLINE — real-time multiplayer traditional card game (6–A deck) with private rooms

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: vitest run && npm run test -w client
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck -w client
